VERDICT write_paths: read the declared write paths (reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround and its node file, docs/figures/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-harness-home-is-not-in-the-worktree) and every path in the delivered diff - reckon/_backends.py and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-harness-home-is-not-in-the-worktree.html - lies inside them, with the fragment directory and file both declared.
